request.style: English, male solo voice with warm choir backing, acoustic guitar, soft piano, cello, hand drum, uplifting and reverent, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Among the priests a name is found
From the sons of Jeshua known
Maaseiah stood with them
To face the weight of sin

[Chorus]
They pledged to send the wives away
And being guilty stood in day
A ram from flock was offered up
To cleanse the heart and wash the cup

[Verse]
On a wooden platform high
Ezra opened up the eye
Beside him Maaseiah stood
With others in the crowd

[Chorus]
They pledged to send the wives away
And being guilty stood in day
A ram from flock was offered up
To cleanse the heart and wash the cup

[Verse]
The Levites explained the Law
While the people stood in awe
Maaseiah spoke with clear sound
Guiding the minds that were bound

[Chorus]
They pledged to send the wives away
And being guilty stood in day
A ram from flock was offered up
To cleanse the heart and wash the cup

[Outro]
The Lord's work is done with grace
In the restored holy place
